| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "cloudsql_database" AND TRANGE(?_tstart, ?_tend)
| STATS marker = SUM(COUNT_OVER_TIME(`metrics.cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/mysql/queries`)) BY database_id
| WHERE marker > 0
| EVAL instance = SUBSTRING(database_id, LOCATE(database_id, ":") + 1)
| KEEP instance
| LIMIT 1

query.esql: ROW `Open` = "View metrics in Discover"
ROW `Open` = "View metrics in Discover"

embeddableConfig.description: Opens this instance's metric documents in Discover for the current time range.

Identity, state and capacity of the selected instance: project, region, Cloud SQL state, partial downtime minutes, vCPUs, RAM and disk size, average CPU and memory utilization, connections, disk used and HA failover readiness.
esql_query:
TS metrics-gcp.cloudsql_mysql.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "cloudsql_database" AND TRANGE(?_tstart, ?_tend)
| STATS st = MAX(state) WHERE `metrics.cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/instance_state` == 1,
        up = MAX(MAX_OVER_TIME(`metrics.cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/up`)), cores = MAX(MAX_OVER_TIME(`metrics.cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/cpu/reserved_cores`)),
        memq = MAX(MAX_OVER_TIME(`metrics.cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/memory/quota`)), diskq = MAX(MAX_OVER_TIME(`metrics.cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/disk/quota`)),
        disk = MAX(MAX_OVER_TIME(`metrics.cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/disk/utilization`)), cpu = (SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(`metrics.cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/cpu/utilization`)) / SUM(COUNT_OVER_TIME(`metrics.cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/cpu/utilization`))),
        mem = (SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(`metrics.cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/memory/utilization`)) / SUM(COUNT_OVER_TIME(`metrics.cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/memory/utilization`))), conns = SUM(MAX_OVER_TIME(`metrics.cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/network/connections`)),
        r = SUM(COUNT_OVER_TIME(`metrics.cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/uptime`)) WHERE `metrics.cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/uptime` > 0 AND `metrics.cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/uptime` < 55,
        fo = MAX(MAX_OVER_TIME(`metrics.cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/available_for_failover`)), marker = SUM(COUNT_OVER_TIME(`metrics.cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/mysql/queries`))
  BY `@timestamp` = TBUCKET(1 minute), instance_id = database_id, project_id, region
| STATS state = LAST(st, CASE(st IS NOT NULL, `@timestamp`, NULL)), last_up = LAST(up, CASE(up IS NOT NULL, `@timestamp`, NULL)),
        last_reserved_cores = LAST(cores, CASE(cores IS NOT NULL, `@timestamp`, NULL)),
        last_memory_quota = LAST(memq, CASE(memq IS NOT NULL, `@timestamp`, NULL)),
        last_disk_quota = LAST(diskq, CASE(diskq IS NOT NULL, `@timestamp`, NULL)),
        last_disk_utilization = LAST(disk, CASE(disk IS NOT NULL, `@timestamp`, NULL)),
        avg_cpu_utilization = AVG(cpu), avg_memory_utilization = AVG(mem),
        last_connections = LAST(conns, CASE(conns IS NOT NULL, `@timestamp`, NULL)),
        partial_downtime = COALESCE(SUM(r), 0), last_failover = LAST(fo, CASE(fo IS NOT NULL, `@timestamp`, NULL)), marker = SUM(marker)
  BY instance_id, project_id, region
| WHERE marker > 0
| SORT avg_cpu_utilization DESC
| LIMIT 1

| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "cloudsql_database"
| STATS t = (SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(`metrics.cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/mysql/threads`)) / SUM(COUNT_OVER_TIME(`metrics.cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/mysql/threads`))) BY bucket = TBUCKET(75, ?_tstart, ?_tend), thread_kind
| WHERE thread_kind IS NOT NULL
| EVAL `Thread kind` = CASE(thread_kind == "THREADS_CONNECTED", "Connected", thread_kind == "THREADS_RUNNING", "Running", thread_kind == "THREADS_CACHED", "Cached", thread_kind)
| KEEP bucket, `Thread kind`, t

query.esql:
TS metrics-gcp.cloudsql_mysql.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "cloudsql_database"
| STATS _all = SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(`metrics.cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/mysql/connections_count`)), _bad = SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(`metrics.cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/mysql/aborted_connects_count`)), _live = SUM(COUNT_OVER_TIME(`metrics.cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/mysql/connections_count`)) BY `@timestamp` = TBUCKET(1 minute)
| INLINE STATS _mins = COUNT_DISTINCT(`@timestamp`) WHERE _live > 0 BY bucket = BUCKET(`@timestamp`, 75, ?_tstart, ?_tend)
| STATS _all = SUM(_all), _bad = SUM(_bad), _mins = MAX(_mins) BY bucket
| WHERE _mins > 0
| EVAL succeeded = (_all - COALESCE(_bad, 0)) / (_mins * 60.0), failed = COALESCE(_bad, 0) / (_mins * 60.0)
| KEEP bucket, succeeded, failed

query.esql:
TS metrics-gcp.cloudsql_mysql.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "cloudsql_database" AND TRANGE(?_tstart, ?_tend)
| STATS io = MAX(state) WHERE `metrics.cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/mysql/replication/slave_io_running_state` == 1,
        sq = MAX(state) WHERE `metrics.cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/mysql/replication/slave_sql_running_state` == 1,
        sbm = MAX(MAX_OVER_TIME(`metrics.cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/mysql/replication/seconds_behind_master`)),
        ioe = MAX(MAX_OVER_TIME(`metrics.cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/mysql/replication/last_io_errno`)),
        sqe = MAX(MAX_OVER_TIME(`metrics.cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/mysql/replication/last_sql_errno`))
  BY `@timestamp` = TBUCKET(1 minute), database_id
| STATS io = LAST(io, CASE(io IS NOT NULL, `@timestamp`, NULL)), sq = LAST(sq, CASE(sq IS NOT NULL, `@timestamp`, NULL)),
        sbm = LAST(sbm, CASE(sbm IS NOT NULL, `@timestamp`, NULL)), peak = MAX(sbm),
        ioe = LAST(ioe, CASE(ioe IS NOT NULL, `@timestamp`, NULL)), sqe = LAST(sqe, CASE(sqe IS NOT NULL, `@timestamp`, NULL))
  BY database_id
| WHERE io IS NOT NULL OR sq IS NOT NULL
| EVAL `Replica` = MV_LAST(SPLIT(database_id, ":"))
| RENAME io AS `IO thread`, sq AS `SQL thread`, sbm AS `Seconds behind source`, peak AS `Peak seconds behind`, ioe AS `Last IO error`, sqe AS `Last SQL error`
| KEEP `Replica`, `IO thread`, `SQL thread`, `Seconds behind source`, `Peak seconds behind`, `Last IO error`, `Last SQL error`

TS metrics-gcp.cloudsql_mysql.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "cloudsql_database" AND TRANGE(?_tstart, ?_tend)
| STATS io = MAX(state) WHERE `metrics.cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/mysql/replication/slave_io_running_state` == 1,
        sq = MAX(state) WHERE `metrics.cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/mysql/replication/slave_sql_running_state` == 1,
        sbm = MAX(MAX_OVER_TIME(`metrics.cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/mysql/replication/seconds_behind_master`)),
        ioe = MAX(MAX_OVER_TIME(`metrics.cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/mysql/replication/last_io_errno`)),
        sqe = MAX(MAX_OVER_TIME(`metrics.cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/mysql/replication/last_sql_errno`))
  BY `@timestamp` = TBUCKET(1 minute), database_id
| STATS io = LAST(io, CASE(io IS NOT NULL, `@timestamp`, NULL)), sq = LAST(sq, CASE(sq IS NOT NULL, `@timestamp`, NULL)),
        sbm = LAST(sbm, CASE(sbm IS NOT NULL, `@timestamp`, NULL)), peak = MAX(sbm),
        ioe = LAST(ioe, CASE(ioe IS NOT NULL, `@timestamp`, NULL)), sqe = LAST(sqe, CASE(sqe IS NOT NULL, `@timestamp`, NULL))
  BY database_id
| WHERE io IS NOT NULL OR sq IS NOT NULL
| EVAL `Replica` = MV_LAST(SPLIT(database_id, ":"))
| RENAME io AS `IO thread`, sq AS `SQL thread`, sbm AS `Seconds behind source`, peak AS `Peak seconds behind`, ioe AS `Last IO error`, sqe AS `Last SQL error`
| KEEP `Replica`, `IO thread`, `SQL thread`, `Seconds behind source`, `Peak seconds behind`, `Last IO error`, `Last SQL error`
